items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: there was another bunch of musicians that I didn’t know too well and that was Doc Evans

ctx.x: What was the musical atmosphere like in your town?

Well bebop was being born around that time. When I was growing up, when I was in high school and at the University of Minnesota, I was a member of bebop groups. I mean we called ourselves bebop groups and we tried to imitate the music that we heard on recordings. And the bands around town that were working in the clubs were bebop groups. Now there was another bunch of musicians that I didn’t know too well and that was Doc Evans and some other players who were the traditional players. And there was a strong scene…
Okay, so you guys were thinking pretty modern then. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
